title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode14 Feelings Grow

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are!
I wish I could've stayed a little longer...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
But it was nice to see what that SEKAI was like back then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how long those other versions of us had been watching over everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, they were all doing their best to make sure everyone would discover their true feelings!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And coming up with ways to help support them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They were working really hard to make sure they'd be there for everyone when that time came.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not being able to get the others to realize that SEKAI existed did become a little frustrating at times.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they kept doing their best to help everyone despite their struggles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they've become a huge source of support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then and now, including this very moment...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did the sprouts in their SEKAI just grow bigger...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This must also be one of SEKAI's powers.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
What kind of plant do you think they are?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Woooow!!
This place is so pretty!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Where are we?
It doesn't look like anyone's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This could be a new SEKAI that was collectively born out of all of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I've actually been here before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You need to see this tree!
Everyone's feelings are hanging from it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right...!
And they all involve different things...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is this a CD...?
Oh, it's Leo/need's debut single.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I found some pictures of Minori and the others, and some of their merch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Check it out, MEIKO!
There's a flyer for RAD BLAST!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm finding posters Tsukasa and his troupe made for their shows as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's a pile of sheet music over here...
Oh, and some apples.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There really are a lot of things hanging from this tree. And they're all clear representations of everyone's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Their feelings, along with ours, made it grow this big.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, when you look at it as a whole, it does feel like we overcame a lot together to help make their dreams come true. That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And it's grown so much since the last time I was here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That must be a reflection of just how much everyone else has grown.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's growing with them...?
That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it is! Also, that means it's gonna keep growing bigger and bearing more fruits!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll definitely be looking forward to seeing that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(A SEKAI made out of everybody's feelings...
And it changes little by little as they grow.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wonder what's going to happen here moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I can't say for certain right now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'd like to keep watching over them...!
